method.scan_protocol: hip_flexion_r over the deposit's own declared range, all other coordinates at model-file defaults (the pulley lane's protocol); r = -dL/dq central differences; r<0 = extensor, r>0 = flexor
method.sign_gate: per-muscle per-q (the ankle book's sign law): a class muscle contributes F*|r| only where its derived arm is NEGATIVE about hip_flexion_r (extension)
